note: Form Tips is a client-side module that turns Drupal form descriptions into tooltips. All persistent state is the single config object formtips.settings (route formtips.setting_form at /admin/config/user-interface/formtips, permission 'administer formtips'). Keys: formtips_trigger_action ('click' default / 'hover'), formtips_max_width ('500px' default), formtips_selectors (newline CSS/jQuery selectors to exclude), formtips_themes ({} = all), and the hover-only hoverIntent knobs formtips_hoverintent/interval/sensitivity/timeout. Medium cases set a known value in that config and read it back; hard cases change a real key and verify against live config.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module Form Tips, which setting controls whether a field's description tooltip appears on hover versus on click, and what are its two possible values?
evals.expected_output: The formtips_trigger_action setting in formtips.settings controls it; its values are 'click' (the default) and 'hover'.

evals.prompt: Where does Form Tips store its configuration on a Drupal 11 site, and at what admin path / route is its settings form? Which permission protects it?
evals.expected_output: All settings are in the formtips.settings config object; the form is at /admin/config/user-interface/formtips (route formtips.setting_form), protected by the 'administer formtips' permission.

evals.prompt: On a Form Tips-enabled Drupal site, how do I stop certain form fields from being converted into tooltips, and how is that value formatted?
evals.expected_output: Set formtips_selectors in formtips.settings to a newline-separated list of CSS/jQuery selectors; elements matching those selectors are excluded from tooltip conversion.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site Form Tips is configured with a specific maximum tooltip width. Inspect the live formtips configuration and state the exact value of the tooltip max-width setting.
This site has Form Tips configured to exclude one selector from tooltip conversion. Inspect the live configuration and give the exact selector that is excluded.
On this Drupal site, configure Form Tips so that description tooltips open on hover instead of on click. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set formtips.settings:formtips_trigger_action to 'hover' (e.g. drush cset formtips.settings formtips_trigger_action hover -y, or via the settings form).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make Form Tips tooltips at most 640px wide. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set formtips.settings:formtips_max_width to '640px' (e.g. drush cset formtips.settings formtips_max_width '640px' -y).
